title.en: I Bear Witness: The Meaning of the Two Testimonies
title.tl: Ako ay Sumasaksi: Ang Kahulugan ng Dalawang Pagsaksi

source.site_section: أتعرف على أركان الإسلام › الركن الأول (tab5_1)

text.ar:
الركن الأول: شهادة أنَّ لا إله إلا الله وأنَّ محمدًا رسول الله.
قال تعالى:
text.en:
First Pillar: Shahādah (To bear witness that there is no god except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah).
Allah Almighty says:
text.tl:
Ang Unang Haligi
Ang Shadatayn o pagsasaksi na walang diyos na karapat-dapat sambahin maliban sa Allah at si Muhammad ay Sugo ng Allah.
Sinabi ng Allah:

text.ar: وقال تعالى:
text.en: He also says:
text.tl: Sinabi pa ng Allah:

text.ar: معنى شهادة أنَّ لا إله إلا الله: لا معبودَ حقٌّ إلا الله.
text.en: The Shahādah that "There is no god but Allah" means that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
text.tl: Ang kahulugan ng pagsasaksi: Walang ibang diyos na karapat-dapat sambahin maliban sa Allah.

text.ar: معنى شهادة أنَّ محمدًا رسول الله: طاعته فيما أمر، وتصديقه فيما أخبر، واجتناب ما نهى عنه وزجر، وألا يُعَبد الله إلا بما شرع.
text.en: The Shahādah that “Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah” means that it is obligatory to obey his orders, believe what he related, avoid what he forbade and warned against, and worship Allah only in the manner he instructed.
text.tl: Ang kahulugan ng pagsasaksi na si Muhammad ay Sugo ng Allah: Ang pagsunod sa kanyang utos, paniniwala sa kanyang ibinalita, pag-iwas sa kanyang ipinagbawal, at pagsamba sa Allah alinsunod sa kanyang itinuro.

text.ar: يعرف معنى شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله: لا معبود حق إلا الله
text.en: Knows the meaning of the testimony that there is no god but Allah: there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah
text.tl: Alam ang kahulugan ng pagsaksi na walang diyos maliban sa Allah: walang ibang diyos na karapat-dapat sambahin maliban sa Allah

text.ar: يعرف معنى شهادة أن محمدًا رسول الله
text.en: Knows the meaning of the testimony that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
text.tl: Alam ang kahulugan ng pagsaksi na si Muhammad ay Sugo ng Allah

text.ar: يعرف أن الشهادتين هما الركن الأول من أركان الإسلام
text.en: Knows that the two testimonies are the first pillar of Islam
text.tl: Alam na ang dalawang pagsaksi ang unang haligi ng Islam

prompt.ar: ما معنى شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله؟
prompt.en: What does the testimony "there is no god but Allah" mean?
prompt.tl: Ano ang kahulugan ng pagsaksi na walang diyos maliban sa Allah?

text.ar: لا معبودَ حقٌّ إلا الله
text.en: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah
text.tl: Walang ibang diyos na karapat-dapat sambahin maliban sa Allah

text.ar: طاعة النبي ﷺ فيما أمر
text.en: Obeying the orders of the Prophet ﷺ
text.tl: Ang pagsunod sa utos ng Propeta ﷺ

text.ar: أن محمدًا رسول الله
text.en: That Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
text.tl: Na si Muhammad ay Sugo ng Allah

prompt.ar: مما يدخل في معنى شهادة أن محمدًا رسول الله:

text.ar: أن يُعبد الله بغير ما شرع
text.en: Worshipping Allah in a way other than what he instructed
text.tl: Ang pagsamba sa Allah sa paraang hindi niya itinuro

text.ar: طاعته فيما أمر، وتصديقه فيما أخبر
text.en: Obeying his orders and believing what he related
text.tl: Ang pagsunod sa kanyang utos at paniniwala sa kanyang ibinalita

text.ar: فعل ما نهى عنه وزجر
text.en: Doing what he forbade and warned against
text.tl: Ang paggawa ng kanyang ipinagbawal

text.en: Obeying his orders, believing what he related, avoiding what he forbade, and worshipping Allah only in the manner he instructed

text.tl: Ang pagiging Sugo ni Muhammad lamang
